command:
set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- release/kernel/boot ---'
cat /etc/redhat-release 2>/dev/null || cat /etc/os-release
uname -r
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- block/lvm/mounts ---'
lsblk -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINT
command -v pvs || true
command -v vgs || true
command -v lvs || true
pvs 2>/dev/null || true
vgs 2>/dev/null || true
lvs -a -o+devices 2>/dev/null || true
df -hT
printf '%s\n' '--- candidate disks ---'

systemctl --failed --no-legend 2>/dev/null || true

set -eu
sudo -n sh -c 'printf "persistent payload created before online growth\n" > /srv/data/marker.txt'
sudo -n dd if=/dev/urandom of=/srv/data/payload.bin bs=1M count=8 status=none
sudo -n sync
printf '%s\n' '--- pre-growth mounted state ---'
findmnt -n -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS,MAJ:MIN /srv/data
grep ' /srv/data ' /proc/self/mountinfo
sudo -n lvs --units g --nosuffix -o lv_name,vg_name,lv_size,lv_attr /dev/data_vg/data_lv
df -BG /srv/data
printf '%s\n' '--- pre-growth contents/checksums ---'
sudo -n ls -l /srv/data
sudo -n sha256sum /srv/data/marker.txt /srv/data/payload.bin

set -eu
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/setup-data-loop >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_SETUP'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
/sbin/modprobe loop
attached=$(/sbin/losetup -j /var/lib/lvm-data.img | /usr/bin/cut -d: -f1)
if [ -n "$attached" ]; then
    [ "$attached" = /dev/loop0 ] || { echo "backing file already attached to $attached" >&2; exit 1; }
else
    if /sbin/losetup /dev/loop0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "/dev/loop0 is already in use" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    /sbin/losetup /dev/loop0 /var/lib/lvm-data.img
fi
/sbin/lvm pvscan --cache /dev/loop0
/sbin/lvm vgchange -ay data_vg
ANTRIEB_SETUP
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/setup-data-loop
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Attach persistent loop PV for /srv/data
After=systemd-udev-settle.service
Before=srv-data.mount

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/setup-data-loop
ExecStop=-/sbin/lvm vgchange -an data_vg
ExecStop=-/sbin/losetup -d /dev/loop0

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/srv-data.mount.d

[Unit]
Requires=srv-data-loop.service

ANTRIEB_DROPIN
printf '%s\n' '/dev/mapper/data_vg-data_lv /srv/data xfs defaults 0 0' | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab >/dev/null
sudo -n restorecon -v /usr/local/sbin/setup-data-loop /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service /etc/systemd/system/srv-data.mount.d/10-loop.conf /etc/fstab 2>/dev/null || true
